data.narrative:
Skyeton is a Growth-stage company in the Defense & Security sector founded by Oleksandr Stepura. The valuation exercise draws from a broader comp universe of 26 same-sector peers, comprising 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms. Top private comparables include Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

Standard peer-median methodology was not applicable to this analysis. The Defense & Security sector contains 26 total peers, but applying stage-alignment and valuation-tier filters yielded fewer than three datapoints in any narrow cohort, falling short of the minimum threshold required for reliable median derivation. Relying on an all-sector median would introduce substantial distortion given Skyeton's specialized position within a fragmented market.

Given the constraints on peer-based triangulation, this valuation cannot be supported by quantitative methods using the available dataset. A complete analysis would require either: (1) expansion of comparable company data within the narrow Defense & Security growth-stage band, or (2) introduction of alternative methodologies (transaction multiples, DCF analysis, or industry-benchmarked metrics) with underlying financials. Without sufficient comparable data or alternate input parameters, no valuation range can be responsibly derived at this stage.
